proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ _ P
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hp : IsStarProjection P := ⟨h1, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := isStarProjection_iff_eq_starProjection_range.mp hp
    have hc : IsClosed (((P : H →ₗ[𝕜] H).range : Submodule 𝕜 H) : Set H) := ContinuousLinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.isClosed_range h1
    exact ⟨_, hc.completeSpace_coe, h4⟩
  · rintro ⟨K, hK, rfl⟩
    have h := isStarProjection_starProjection (U := K)
    exact ⟨h.isIdempotentElem, h.isSelfAdjoint⟩
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H] (P : H →L[𝕜] H), (P * P = P ∧ ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint P = P) ↔ ∃ (K : Submodule 𝕜 H) (_ : CompleteSpace K), P = K.starProjection
